FIRST AMENDMENT
to Lease Agreement
by and between
Chaudhry Mubah Sultan ("Lessor") and Zameen Platinum (Private) Limited ("Lessee")
[Each a Party" and, collectively, "Parties"]
This first amendment (First Amendment') to the Lease Agreement dated 12th December 2023 (Lease
Agreement") is made and entered into at Lahore on this 6th January, 2025.
WHEREAS
(A)

The Parties entered into the Lease Agreement wherein the Lessor granted on rent, and the Lessee
took on rent from the Lessor, the entire plot No. 35-H, measuring 2 Kanal — 1 Maral — 158 sq.ft.
located atGulberg Ill, Lahore ("Demised Premises"); and

(B)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Lease Agreement as per the terms
and conditions of this First Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The First Amendment shall come into force on 15th December, 2024 (Effective Date").

c

E-STAM P
CONTINUATION SHEET

2.

Pursuant to Clause 2.1 of the Lease Agreement, the Parties hereby mutually agree to further extend
the term of the Lease Agreement for three (3) months and fifteen (15) days, commencing from the
Effective Date and ending on 31st March, 2025 ('Extended Term").

3.

The Parties agree that during the Extended Term the monthly rent payable by the Lessee to the
Lessor for the Demised Premises shall remain same that is Rs. 275,000 (Rupees Two Hundred
Seventy-five Thousand per month exclusive of all applicable taxes ("Monthly Rent").

4.

The First Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Lease Agreement.

5.

All other terms and provisions in the Lease Agreement shall mutatis mutandis apply and shall
continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any
conflict, the terms of this First Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting term in the Lease
Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Lease Agreement shall bear the same meaning in
this First Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.

7.

This First Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall
constitute one and the same amendment.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this First Amendment, having fully understood
the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.

SIGNED

For and on behalf Li-Y
Chaudhry Mubah Sultan

For and on behalf of Lessee
